description: src/ir_interp/dispatch_exec.rs and src/ir_interp/backend.rs carried their tests inline (594 and 1236 lines), while the crate's convention at 23 sites is a sibling <module>_test.rs mounted with #[path]. The epic added nine tests to the first and one to the second; both whole modules move to dispatch_exec_test.rs and backend_test.rs so the production files read as production and the tests as tests. No test changes.
title: The interpreter's test modules live in sibling files
